data.long_description:
Experience elevated living in this stunning 4-bedroom villa in the prestigious Palmiera community. Designed with generous layouts, contemporary architecture, and premium finishing, this home offers the perfect blend of space, comfort, and sophistication.

Property Features:

4 Spacious Bedrooms – all en-suite
7 Bathrooms – including guest bathrooms
Large Formal Living & Dining Area
Modern Open-Plan Kitchen with high-end fittings
Maid’s Room + Laundry Room
Floor-to-Ceiling Windows bringing in natural light
Private Garden & Terrace
Covered Parking

Community Highlights:

Gated family-friendly environment
Swimming pools & fitness facilities
Parks, green spaces & walking trails
Children’s play areas
Close proximity to schools, retail, and dining

This exceptional villa is ideal for families seeking upscale living in a vibrant, well-connected community.
